inputs.caption: Modern hard-hitting trap rap beat with aggressive 808 basslines, tight hi-hat rolls, dark melodic piano, energetic male rap vocals with fast rhythmic cadence
inputs.lyrics:
[intro]
Yeah, turn the beat up
Mic check one two, let's get it

[verse 1]
Step in the cypher, flow sharper than steel
Living in the matrix but the passion is real
Code on the screen, rhythm pumping through veins
Turning every single obstacle to digital gains

[chorus]
We never slow down, we ride with the sound
Heavy bass booming when we shake the whole ground
Crown on the vision, no limit in sight
Spitting pure lightning through the dark of the night

[outro]
Yeah, that's how we do it
Antigravity flow, signing off
